technique_name: Explain the dynamics of a risky relationship.
description: When we think of a risky relationship, we often think of the exhilaration of adventure, excitement, and even passion. However, these relationships can also be high risk as they can quickly become unhealthy or even toxic. While they may be intense, they can involve a great deal of instability, insecurity, and manipulation.
